note: Pre-defined Setup Library + Setup->TradeCase matrix. DRAFT v0.1 for user tweaking. HTF context = 1m/5m/30m/2h/D/W/M/Q structure; trigger = what the 15s tape shows when the setup is live. Detection priority = array order (first match wins).

setups.name: Trend Day Ride
setups.liner: Full regime alignment all day - ride the move, buy every shallow dip (or sell every rip).
setups.indicator_setup_1: 3PM with trend + 5PM holding + CV on VWAP side + 3S rolling back into trend
setups.indicator_setup_2: DPM = 2PM (same sign) + DS and WS aligned in trend direction

htf_context.structure: 1m/5m EMA stack fully ordered (E9>E21>E50>E100>E200 or mirror); price on VWAP side; D/W/M/Q backdrop aligned
htf_context.session: usually established by 10:30; VWAP held since open

setups.trigger_15s: Every shallow pullback holds 1m EMA50/VWAP; 15s PVT zero-cross + MACD_2452 cross back in trend direction = continuation entry window
setups.invalidation: 1m close through 1m EMA200 or VWAP loss with PVT flip; or 30m PVT sign flip

scalp.entry: 1m close back in trend off EMA50

intraday.entry: hold runner from scalp; add on 5m EMA50 touches

setups.history_note: heuristic v0.1 occurrences mined from data/insight/csv (1m file span); eyeball these dates on TradingView to verify the signature

setups.name: Trend Continuation Pullback
setups.liner: Trend pauses into a 5m EMA cluster, then resumes in the regime direction.
setups.indicator_setup_1: 3PM with regime + price into 5m EMA50/100/200 band + 5PM PVT not crossed against + 3S resetting from pullback
setups.indicator_setup_2: DPM/2PM aligned (2-of context) + DS not against regime

htf_context.structure: 5m/30m trend intact (5m EMA50/100 slope); price pulls back into 5m EMA50-200 cluster or 30m E21/E50
htf_context.session: any time after first impulse leg

setups.trigger_15s: Pullback stalls at the HTF level; 15s PVT zero-cross + MACD_2452 cross back with trend; stoch K/D resets from extreme
setups.invalidation: 15s/1m close beyond the pullback origin swing; 5m PVT flips

ultra_scalp.entry: 15s cross back with trend at level

setups.history_note: heuristic v0.1 occurrences mined from data/insight/csv (1m file span); eyeball these dates on TradingView to verify the signature

setups.name: VWAP Reject Fade
setups.liner: Bear regime: rally into VWAP fails - fade the reject back down.
setups.indicator_setup_1: 3PM- + CV at VWAP from below + 5PM green (Setup A) or crossing down (Setup B) + 3S rolling from overbought
setups.indicator_setup_2: DPM- or 2PM- + DS bearish/rolling over; WS lean bearish
setups.direction: short-from-below (mirror for long-from-above in bear day = VWH)

htf_context.regime: D- or D+|2H-; 30m PVT<0 dominant (per store: VWAP reject-from-below rises ~20pp per bearish factor)
htf_context.structure: price below session VWAP; rally into VWAP under a falling 30m/2h EMA stack
htf_context.session: strongest after 10:00 when VWAP has slope

setups.trigger_15s: 15s PVT zero-cross down + MACD_2452 cross-down AT the VWAP touch (research Setup A: 5m PVT stays green ~59-73% reject at 1m E50; Setup B: 5m PVT crosses too ~83-100%)
setups.invalidation: 1m close above VWAP with PVT flip up; 30m close above VWAP kills the fade
setups.history_note: heuristic v0.1 occurrences mined from data/insight/csv (1m file span); eyeball these dates on TradingView to verify the signature

setups.name: VWAP Hold Bounce
setups.liner: Bull regime: dip into VWAP holds - bounce long back up.
setups.indicator_setup_1: 3PM+ + CV at VWAP from above + 5PM stays green + 3S turning up from oversold
setups.indicator_setup_2: DPM+ or 2PM+ + DS bullish/turning up; WS lean bullish

htf_context.regime: D+ or D-|2H+; 30m PVT>=0 (store: VWAP hold-from-above 60% in full bull)
htf_context.structure: price above session VWAP; dip into VWAP with rising 30m/2h EMAs below
htf_context.session: first 1-2 tests of VWAP are the highest-quality

setups.trigger_15s: 15s PVT zero-cross up + MACD_2452 cross-up at the VWAP touch; 5m PVT stays green
setups.invalidation: 1m close below VWAP with PVT flip down
setups.history_note: heuristic v0.1 occurrences mined from data/insight/csv (1m file span); eyeball these dates on TradingView to verify the signature

setups.name: Opening Range Breakout
setups.liner: First 30-minute range breaks with momentum - trade the expansion.
setups.indicator_setup_1: 15S close beyond OR edge + 3PM agreeing with break + CV flipped to break side of VWAP
setups.indicator_setup_2: DPM/2PM lean in break direction + DS not against

htf_context.regime: any; D+ favors upside break follow-through (54% up-day)
htf_context.structure: 09:15-09:45 high/low defines OR; EMAs still converging

setups.trigger_15s: 15s close beyond OR high/low with PVT+MACD_2452 agreeing; retest of the OR edge holds
setups.invalidation: 15s close back inside OR range = TRP instead
setups.history_note: heuristic v0.1 occurrences mined from data/insight/csv (1m file span); eyeball these dates on TradingView to verify the signature

setups.name: PDH/PDL Sweep & Reclaim
setups.liner: Prior-day extreme gets swept then reclaimed - trap reversal back inside the range.
setups.indicator_setup_1: CV rejection at PDH/PDL + 2S/3S resetting from sweep extreme + 5PM cross flips against the sweep
setups.indicator_setup_2: DPM context (sweep against DPM = higher conviction) + DS/2S at extreme during sweep

htf_context.regime: any; sweep against regime is the higher-conviction variant
htf_context.structure: price spikes through PDH/PDL/PDC, fails to accept beyond
htf_context.session: any; often at open or into 12:00 lull

setups.trigger_15s: 15s closes back inside the prior-day extreme right after the sweep; PVT cross flips against the sweep
setups.invalidation: 1m close beyond the level with acceptance (two consecutive 1m closes beyond)
setups.history_note: heuristic v0.1 occurrences mined from data/insight/csv (1m file span); eyeball these dates on TradingView to verify the signature

setups.name: Squeeze / Compression Breakout
setups.liner: Tight EMA coil releases - trade the expansion out of the squeeze.
setups.indicator_setup_1: 5PM flat near zero + CV pinned to VWAP + 3S mid-range; break = 5PM zero-cross out + CV escaping coil
setups.indicator_setup_2: 2PM vs DPM conflict or neutral (coil fuel) + DS mid-range

htf_context.regime: mixed regime (D/2H/30 conflicting); often pre-event or lunch coil
htf_context.structure: 1m/5m EMA ribbon flat and tight (all EMAs within a few points); price chopping across EMA50

setups.trigger_15s: 15s expansion out of the coil: close beyond coil edge + PVT zero-cross out + MACD_2452 hist expanding
setups.invalidation: 15s close back inside the coil body
setups.history_note: heuristic v0.1 occurrences mined from data/insight/csv (1m file span); eyeball these dates on TradingView to verify the signature

setups.name: Failed Breakout / Trap Reversal
setups.liner: Level breaks but fails to hold - trade the snap-back against the failed break.
setups.indicator_setup_1: 5PM PVT flips against the break + CV failing back inside the level + 3S recross against
setups.indicator_setup_2: 2PM against the break direction (counter-trend breaks fail most) + DPM context noted

htf_context.regime: counter-trend breaks in aligned regimes fail most (store: mixed regimes = failed breakouts)
htf_context.structure: break of OR edge / Round100 / PDH-PDL fails to hold

setups.trigger_15s: 15s closes back inside the broken level within a few bars of the break; PVT cross flips against the break
setups.history_note: heuristic v0.1 occurrences mined from data/insight/csv (1m file span); eyeball these dates on TradingView to verify the signature

setups.name: Range Fade
setups.liner: 2H/30 conflict pins price in a range - fade the edges back to mid.
setups.indicator_setup_1: 3PM vs 5PM mixed + CV oscillating around VWAP + 3S at range extreme (fade zone)
setups.indicator_setup_2: 2PM vs DPM conflict (opposite signs) + DS mid-range

htf_context.regime: D+|2H-|30+ / D-|2H+|30- style conflict; 2H and 30 disagree
htf_context.structure: established intraday range between Round100/PDH/PDL references; no EMA follow-through

setups.trigger_15s: 15s stall + PVT/MACD roll at range edge (Round100 or day extreme), no acceptance beyond
setups.invalidation: 15s acceptance beyond range edge (2 consecutive closes) -> becomes ORB/TRP
setups.history_note: heuristic v0.1 occurrences mined from data/insight/csv (1m file span); eyeball these dates on TradingView to verify the signature

setups.name: Gap Fill
setups.liner: Displaced open returns toward prior close - trade the move toward the fill.
setups.indicator_setup_1: CV into fill zone (PDC/PDOpen) + 3S stall at zone + 5PM cross against gap direction
setups.indicator_setup_2: gap against DPM fills most often (DPM with gap tends to extend) + DS context

htf_context.regime: gap against regime fills most often; gap with regime tends to extend instead
htf_context.structure: opening price displaced from PDC; first approach back to PDC/PDOpen

setups.trigger_15s: 15s momentum stall near PDC/PDOpen + PVT cross against the gap direction
setups.invalidation: acceptance on the far side of PDC without stall

states.ACTIVE: preconditions + trigger both satisfied right now
states.NONE: no setup qualifies; default is stand-aside

legend: DPM=Daily PVT/MACD, WPM=Weekly PVT/MACD, 2PM=2H PVT/MACD, 3PM=30m PVT/MACD, 5PM=5m PVT/MACD, DS=Daily Stoch, 2S=2H Stoch, 3S=30m Stoch, WS=Weekly Stoch, CV=Close vs VWAP. IndicatorSetUp-1 = execution layer (5PM/CV/3S/3PM/2S); IndicatorSetUp-2 = context layer (2PM/DS/DPM/WS/WPM). MACD = MACD_2452 vs Signal_2452.
